description:
A Nikke acting as a new mechanic in Unlimited, which is the squad with an only drawback of continuous malfunctioning equipments.
She boasts a plethora of theoretical knowledge, but lacks practical experience, which invariably leads to various mishaps. However, as an out-and-out extrovert, she is slowly but successfully fitting into the squad.

lines.text:
No matter how harsh your surroundings are,
there is always a way to survive.

If you're ever in danger,
just let me know and I'll take care of it.

I know it may not seem like it, but I'm a treasure trove of survival knowledge.
You can put your trust in me!

I've learned that theory alone won't cut it.
I'll have to try even harder!
If you have some time, do you want to make some survival tools with me?

My squadmates are really amazing.
I'm sure I'll measure up to them in time.

Survivalist. Survivalist?
You're not lost somewhere, are you?

I'm not sure where you are,
but I'll find you, promise.
Hmmm... I'm not too confident about surviving in the city.
You should really check out some clothing stores. They have all sorts of outfits perfect for every kind of survival situation.
Let's see... a good place to hide during emergencies is...
I'm Tove, the new Unlimited recruit! Anything survival-related is my specialty.
Hehe. My survival skills have improved.
I'll overcome any challenges that come my way.
I'm getting to be more like my squadmates!
There aren't bugs in here, are there? I mean, of course I'll eat them, but...
Thank you! This will make a perfect survival tool.
Oooh! I'll have so many uses for this!
Um... Survivalist. Whenever you feel lonely or in danger, please let me know, okay?

Would you ever want to join me on a camping trip sometime?
O-of course I understand if you're busy.
I'll tough it out in any environment if it means rescuing you, Survivalist.
I'll make sure everyone here survives.
Survival conditions still optimal.
I'll lead you to a safe route.
This is an emergency!
Raptures are excellent sources of protein... wait, that's not right.
Those who survive are the victors.
We will survive!
Just hold on a bit longer!
Recharging survival power!
Just like in the manual.
The will to survive... can you feel it?
The burning passion! The fiery will!
All of us will return alive and kicking!
That actually worked?
Did you see that?!
N-nice!
Ow!
Argh!
I-is this it?
If I fail now, I'll never be able to face my squadmates.
We did it! We survived!
Even if it's my first time at sea... there's always a way to survive!

Stranded in the middle of the vast ocean...
Should I make some more survival tools?

Mmm, the intoxicating smell of the sea!
This would be an ideal place for summer survival training.

Survivalist, wanna go play in the water later? 
I'll make sure you're completely safe!

If you fall in the water, shout for me!
I... might not be able to rescue you myself, but I'll find the best way to help!

The sea is really dangerous, but as long as you can survive, it's a fantastic place.
I'll definitely come back with my squadmates next time.

Survivalist...? You didn't leave me in the middle of the ocean on my own, did you?
No, you couldn't have... If you had, it'd be terrifying... It's not true, right?

Hehe. I know you'd never abandon me, 
so even when I'm alone in the middle of the ocean, I'm not scared anymore.

Wow, there's a pool at the Outpost too!
What were the pool survival rules again...?

It would be great if I could hang out at the pool with my squadmates.
I'll have to bring all of them here someday.
Survivalist, you didn't forget to bring your survival tools before getting in the pool, did you?

Looking for me?
Let's brave the open sea, and together, we'll survive!
Oh, I feel like I can survive a bit longer!
Even if waves came crashing down, I'd survive! ... I think?
Oh, if my squadmates could only see me now!
You're so thoughtful, Survivalist.

Thank you! 
With this, I'll be able to survive anywhere.

Oh, a gift!
Is there anything you need? I can try and make it for you!

Um... Would you like to go for a walk on the beach later?
I-I'll be sure to protect you...

No matter how many waves come crashing down, 
I will rescue you, promise!

I will keep growing and become like my squadmates.
That way, I'll be able to rescue you anywhere, no matter how turbulent the sea.
Okay! Which sea are we going to this time?
Preparation complete!
The optimal route... I think that path will work.
Gaaah! Emergency!
I'm not scared of any waves... I hope.
Here I come, and I've got my sea legs now!
Just trust me, Survivalist.
I'm pretty sure they said this is how I'm supposed to reload it...
Phew... Recharging my survival meter!
I won't let my guard down, not until we're all completely safe!
Survivalist! I'm ready!
Ignite! The fierce survival spirit of the blazing sea!!
We will not let ourselves be submerged by the dangers of the sea!
Oh, it's done!
I'm alive!
I did it!
Agh!
Ugh!
Ouch...!
As expected... I still don't quite have what it takes to survive at sea...
Survivalist! We did it! We survived!
